sources.title: voc2vec: A Foundation Model for Non-Verbal Vocalization
sources.snippet: The core contribution of voc2vec lies in the careful selection of diverse, open-source datasets for pre-training, specifically chosen to focus on non-verbal vocalizations. These datasets collectively cover around 125 hours of audio, ensuring that the model is exposed to a wide variety of human vocalizations, typically underrepresented in speech datasets.
